title: Omen / Daybreak and Dawn
overview: The Selector battles are over, and life has returned to normal for the girls who participated. One girl, Kiyoi, feels that the LRIGs might be still out there, plotting, and she asks for help from the winner of the last game.

title: Reason / Hesitation and Resolution
overview: The LRIGs aren't gone after all, and a new wave of Selector Battles is about to begin. Kiyoi fears that they're planning something much bigger and much darker than before.

title: Initiation / Usual and Unusual
overview: The 3rd round of Selector Battles has begin, and this time, there's a new addition to the rules: the Keycards. What changes will they bring to the battles, and why do they exist at all?

title: Crowding / Loser and Winner
overview: Suzuko is forced into the game once more. After being overwhelmed by the power of the keycard, Hitoe's LRIG, Midoriko, is stolen.

title: Gathering / Vortex and Turbid Water
overview: Selectors who were once LRIGs can "Unlock" to fight as LRIGs once more. Yuzuki uses this power to try and get Midoriko back, but... Meanwhile, Chinatsu wants her memories back, and is willing to do whatever it takes to get them

title: Determination / Warmth and Pain
overview: Donor transforms into a keycard to save Chinatsu from Carnival. Donor and Piruluk manage to stave off Slow-ko and Aya's attacks, but then Carnival summons herself into the game!

title: Attachment / Trick and Trap
overview: Chinatsu entrusts Suzuko with Meru, and Ruuko becomes a Selector once more to save her friends.

title: Bond / Crime and Punishment
overview: Akira kidnaps Amika and summons Kiyoi. Akira proposes a battle where Kiyoi will be the one to take Amika hostage.

title: Contact / Key and Keyhole
overview: Suzuko, who jumps into battle to regain Chinatsu's memories, is confronted by a carnival. Meanwhile, Ruko, searching for her missing partner Tama, hears someone's voice.

title: The Eve / Trust and Betrayal
overview: Ruuko and Suzuko begin their battle due to Carnival's scheme. The two continue their duel with equal strength. Then, Kiyoi and her friends discover Ruuko and Suzuko

title: Choice / Battle and Battle
overview: Suzuko sets out to battle the Carnival alongside Liru and Meru. However, the Carnival's "Joker" puts Suzuko in danger.

title: Light
overview: Kiyoi arrived in the room with the white window and stood before Monghan. Unable to tolerate ending the battle, Kiyoi was determined to defeat Monghan and create a new order.
